extracted.name: Rosemary Garlic Pull-Apart Bread
instruction_lines: Combine warm milk, yeast, and sugar and allow to activate for 5-10 min
Add 3 tbs butter, egg, flour, salt, garlic powder, and rosemary to yeast mixture using a rubber spatula. Mix until dough forms a soft cohesive ball
Knead on a lightly-floured surface for 5 min until dough bounces back with a poke (or complete the window pane test)
Rest dough in covered and greased bowl for 1-1.5 hours
Mix 5 tbs butter, rosemary, parsley, garlic, and salt to create filling
Punch down dough and divide into 12 equal portions on lightly-floured surface. Flatten each ball to 4 in diameters and spread filling. Line into buttered bread pan
Cover bread pan and allow to rise in warm environment until puffy, approximately 45 min
Bake at 350° for 50 min on lower third rack
Cool for 10 min in pan and add melted butter and flaky salt if desired
